tool: Raster composition of files that live in this repository. The four background contact sheets are composed by scripts/compose-previews.mjs (dependency-free Node: canvas fill, area-averaged thumbnails, 8-bit RGB output with no ancillary chunk), and the validators recompose their respective pairs and require the same pixels. The two app showcases were composed with a scriptable image tool (their files carry cHRM, bKGD and date text chunks from that re-encoder and nothing else). No new imagery was generated; every pixel derives from the listed inputs and the flat canvas colour.
composedAt: 2026-09-15T19:20:43Z (tIME chunks of the app showcases); the slides-v2 contact sheets were recomposed on 2026-09-16 from the closed-cube set (decision 0013), including after its four recorded precise-object edits; the slides-v3-ambient contact sheets were composed on 2026-09-16 from the additive ambient set (decision 0014). Contact sheets carry no timestamp chunk.
operator: Universal Profiles design-system maintainer (role; no personal name is recorded)
license: The four background-overview contact sheets contain only generated-background pixels and follow the Apache-2.0 terms in LICENSES/GENERATED-IMAGES.md, including its embedded-marks restriction: the thumbnails show the UP! mark on the solid closed official UP! container cubes depicted by the slides-v2 and slides-v3-ambient backgrounds. The mark stays its owner's trademark (TRADEMARKS.md, decisions 0012 through 0014), and the cubes or the mark may not be extracted, cropped out, traced or reused from the sheets any more than from the backgrounds. The two app-showcase previews are mixed compositions: their generated-background pixels follow those generated-image terms, while their embedded app-screen pixels retain the owner-rights, documentation-and-presentation-use-only terms in assets/screenshots/mobile-app/PROVENANCE.json. The app-showcase files are therefore not wholly covered by this repository's Apache-2.0 grant. All six previews are for the README gallery and for choosing files; they are not delivery masters.
rightsNote: Derived previews. Regenerate from the inputs rather than editing (contact sheets: node scripts/compose-previews.mjs); the validator measures every preview against its declared inputs so the pictures can never drift from the files they show.
postProcessing: None beyond the composition itself: backgrounds scaled to fit, screens scaled to about 299 by 634 (the measured best fit of a 300 by 636 target) with a soft shadow, contact-sheet thumbnails area-averaged to 600 by 338 on a #121B21 canvas (the dark canvas token surface.canvas). The contact sheets are written by the script at 8 bits per channel; the showcases were saved at 8 by the image tool.

contract.description: Checked by node scripts/validate.mjs --only rasters: every declared input exists and is listed in its own PROVENANCE.json, and every declared placement matches the input within a mean absolute difference of 6 of 255 after scaling. The branded and ambient checks independently recompose and pin their respective contact-sheet pair with scripts/compose-previews.mjs.
